fairnessRules: A and B may replace data only inside an isolated experiment copy and never execute generated code.
All methods receive the same history and current state; method-specific instructions describe only the output contract and guards.
Invalid JSON, timeout, guard rejection and no-op are recorded as outcomes and never replaced by Mock output.
Retries, if enabled before freezing, use the same fixed limit for all methods and are included in latency and cost.
The evaluator and semantic annotators do not see the system ranking when assigning ground truth labels.
